title: *NO MAIDA* EGGLESS RAGI CHOCOLATE BROWNIES #shorts
description:
Episode 7 of MICROWAVE MAGIC✨a series where I make your favourite desserts at home only in a microwave 🙌🏻Mid-week dessert calls for something easy breezy & absolutely delicious🤎These Microwave Ragi Brownies are soft, fudgy, and packed with rich chocolatey goodness, go try them now 💁🏻‍♂️

Ingredients
🥰½ cup butter
🥰¼ cup dark chocolate
🥰⅓ cup dates powder
🥰½ cup milk, warm
🥰½ cup ragi flour
🥰¼ cup cocoa powder
🥰⅓ cup milk chocolate chunks
🥰2 tbsp dark chocolate chunks

Instructions
1. Add butter and chocolate in a bowl and melt in a microwave at 30 seconds intervals.
2. Add dates powder and milk to the above mixture and mix well.
3. ⁠Add in ragi flour , cocoa powder and chocolate chunks .
4. Mix everything well to form a smooth lumpfree batter.
5. Pour the batter in a greased and lined 5 inch square dish.
6. Top it up with some more chocolate callets and microwave for 3 minutes.
7. Once baked, cut the brownies in equal square and enjoy.
